ns2:section.sectionText: Exploring Gender dialogue In a world increasingly attentive to identity, this course provides space to explore gender within our current context. Topics will include the spectrum of gender identity, language, current events, and skill building for analysis and discussion. Meets 21 March 2022- 4-May-2022. OIIR Dialogue Course. Topic: Exploring Gender Dialogue. Second half session class Offered in collaboration with the Office of Inclusion and Intercultural Relations (OIIR) Course descriptions available at http://go.illinois.edu/EPSY203 for more detailed descriptions of the classes. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can email diversityEd@illinois.edu
